requirement: 用户要求创建新任务，在完成上一个 Core Demo 后继续附件中的 Integration Golden Demo，并创建合适目标。
environment: existing local workspace; existing master branch

predecessor.name: Demo 1 — Browser Automation Core Demo
predecessor.title: Demo 1 — 完整实证 Core PASS 交接
predecessor.continuationReason: User requested a fresh task to resolve plugin visibility/installability and complete Core

successor.name: Demo 2 — OpenDesk Browser Integration Golden Demo
successor.initialization: Register full continuing goal; preserve A–G acceptance and F1–F5 negative qualification conditions; implementation waits for verified predecessor PASS.

releaseConditions: Demo 1 A–D all PASS with source-matched live evidence
Runtime DOM read → variable → fill with independent server verification
Stale and ambiguous/wrong Tab target rejection
Lost ACK has no duplicate submission
Reconnect does not replay unknown side effects

handoff.trigger: After the predecessor's actual full Core PASS audit; before leaving its completed task
handoff.action: Send a single completion handoff to the successor through codex_app__send_message_to_thread, authorizing it to verify the prerequisite then start Demo 2.
handoff.truthRule: The successor rechecks artifacts and evidence. A PASS string or goal status alone cannot release implementation.

scope.predecessor: Finish standalone Core; its only post-PASS continuation is this user-authorized handoff to the separate task.
scope.successor: Existing OpenDesk MCP → same Core → unique authoritative Agent Trace → existing automation-script workflow → ordinary JS → frozen candidate → three new inputs without Agent → Qualification.
scope.stopAfterSuccessorPass: Stop; only suggest Demo 3. Do not implement Human Browser Recorder or Browser+Desktop cross-surface work.
